description: Returns the friend-or-foe verdict for any insect, microbe, or invertebrate slug by checking the beneficial-insects database first, then the pest-disease database. Useful as a routing call before deciding whether to call `get_beneficial_insect` or `get_pest_intelligence`. Return values: `friend` (entry exists in beneficial-insects), `foe` (entry exists in pest-disease with severity high or severe), `nuisance` (pest-disease severity moderate), `cosmetic` (pest-disease severity low), `neutral` (slug not recognized in either fixture).

slug.description: Insect, microbe, or invertebrate slug to classify. Examples: `seven-spotted-ladybug` (friend), `tomato-hornworm` (foe), `parsleyworm` (cosmetic; debatable in apiaceae beds).

name: get_verdict
title: Friend or Foe Classification for Any Insect Slug
